name: Rajan Gupta
tagline: I find where AI products break, slow down, or overspend before users do.
subtitle: AI Product Manager, 15+ years in performance engineering across banking, enterprise SaaS, and the public sector.
supportingBody: I start with the user's problem, then decide what is worth building.
currentRole: Performance Test Lead · Bank of Montreal
aboutParagraphs: I'm an AI Product Manager who starts with the problem and works toward the smallest fix that solves it. At Bank of Montreal, I lead performance and product work on moving on-premise services to AWS Lambda, which improved deployment speed by 40%. Before that, I contributed to 663% revenue growth at MTX Group, from $157K to $1.2M in 14 months, and led the product roadmap for Bank of America's CashPro Mobile, where user retention rose 7%.

For 15+ years in Performance Engineering and Quality Assurance, I have found bottlenecks and audited edge cases, so I ask one question first: what is going wrong for the user, and what does it cost? AI products fail in familiar ways: they are slow, wrong, or too expensive to run. Managing the trade-offs between latency, accuracy, and cost is the daily work of LLM-powered products in 2026.
My working stack: Claude AI for research synthesis, Google AI Studio for rapid prototyping, and n8n for workflow automation.
